full_judgment:
2. Appellants who are plaintiffs filed O.S. No. 19 of 1977 in the 3rd court of Subordinate Judge, Chittagong impleading respondent No. 1 as defendant No. 1 along with other defendants for a decree for establishment of title and confirmation of possession with a prayer for permanent injunction and alternately for khas possession on setting aside order of requisition of the suit property under suction 3 of the (Emergency) Requisition of Property Act, 8948. Plaintiffs also filed an application under Order 39, rules 1 and 2 read with section 151 of the Code of Civil Procedure for temporary injunction restraining defendants from dispossession them till the disposal of the suit. 

 “ That it will not be out of place to mention here in this connection that the defendant having an affable face out-side out having serpentine heart within has become the owner and possessor of '94 sataks of land on 17.10.63 by virtue of Wakf Deed on the day by one A.D.M. Shamsul Huda in favour of Madrasah named Mozharul Ullum Gouchia Senior Madrasah of which defendant No. 1 is the Superintendent as the fortune has favoured such a man. After the execution of the Wakf, the Madrasah house was constructed on a portion of the land and the remaining land stands round about the said Madrasah house. This Madrasah house has been constructed just close to the suit land building on R.S. 6889. Besides this '94 sataks of land the defendant has become owner and possessor of more than '37 ½  sataks of land in ejmali possession against each plot by virtue of the purchase by the sale deeds dated 8.2.65 and 10.2.65. In that way the defendant No. 1 has managed to bring under his control about 13 ½  sataks of land in the disputed locality. The remaining lands besides the land covered by the Madrasah house the defendant No. 1 has possession there in khas." 

 31, Facts in short are as follows: Plaintiff-appellants filed a suit being OS No. 19 of 1977 in the 3rd Court of Subordinate Judge, Chittagong, praying for a decree for establishment of title, confirmation of possession with permanent injunction, alternately, for khas possession and declaring requisition of the suit property as bad in law. He also prayed for temporary injunction till the disposal of the suit.
